items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: The interviewee does not respond to the interviewer's questions about Big Joe Turner; the interviewer provides all information about Turner's venues and current status.

ctx.x: So the guy at the Cotton Club bought a piano. And, uh, I had been banging on the pianos and people at home and places and listening, like I see these clubs. So I figured I was good enough to take a chance in there because there wasn't nothing really happening no harm. Where was the Cotton Club? That was on Ramport between, uh, Caliope and Clio. Really? You had most of your big time clubs then. Around 37, 38, 39, most of your clubs was around in between Caliope and Clio on Ramport. You had the Cotton Club, you had…
Can I ask you a question? Mm-hmm. Where did Big Joe Turner play?
Now, Turner played the Rhythm Club, didn't he? At the Dewdrop most of the time. Dewdrop in the Rhythm Club. Yeah.
